items.title: Denise Morel Interview, 1965-05-07
items.q: You are a friend of Pierre Merlin and Pierre Atlan.

ctx.x: You are a friend of Pierre Merlin and Pierre Atlan. That's how I found out about you. They wrote to me that you were coming. And you told me about that train. You want to say it in French? You want to describe it completely, including the mud?
